'''Perfect-Series control cables''' were a type of [[control cable]]s used in the construction of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]]. Produced by [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]], the Perfect-Series was the most common cables used across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
